claim: Dataset mixture composition is a first-order factor in navigation performance.
minimum_evidence: B0-B3 on >=3 datasets; equal exposure; >=3 seeds; bootstrap CI and factor ablation.
falsifier: Balanced/proportional/specialist differences are within uncertainty across IID and LODO.

claim: A balanced multi-dataset policy improves worst-domain or LODO robustness over proportional mixing and specialists.
minimum_evidence: Frozen grouped splits; per-dataset and worst-domain metrics; matched encoder/params/NFE.
falsifier: No statistically credible worst-domain or LODO gain, or average gain hides a material domain regression.

claim: TinyNavBrain H1 outperforms deterministic H0 under matched parameters and data exposure.
minimum_evidence: Matched fusion/history/encoder; H0 versus H1 at NFE=1; >=3 seeds.
falsifier: H1-H0 interval includes zero on primary closed-loop metric or H0 is better.
downgrade_path: Remove generative-necessity claim; publish H0 or negative result.

claim: H1 offers a better low-NFE quality-latency frontier than DDIM baselines.
minimum_evidence: H1 NFE 1/2/4/8 versus DDIM 2/3 and DDPM10; identical K and hardware; per-call latency.
falsifier: H1 is dominated after matching NFE/K/params or only wins through best-of-K.
downgrade_path: Reframe as an efficiency implementation if latency alone improves.

claim: Multi-dataset training improves corruption and leave-one-dataset-out transfer.
minimum_evidence: Frozen corruption severities and LODO; no target-domain tuning; CIs and failure taxonomy.
falsifier: Gain disappears outside IID or requires target-domain tuning.
downgrade_path: Limit claim to observed in-domain scaling.

claim: Offline improvements predict non-saturated simulation and device-level robot behavior.
minimum_evidence: Pre-registered sim seeds; robot protocol; Orin/full-loop latency; correlation with uncertainty.
falsifier: Offline ranking is flat/reversed in closed loop or device deadline misses erase gains.
downgrade_path: Withhold RA-L method claim and publish benchmark artifact only.
